title: Stopping and waiting pass. Longer turning remains unqualified.
summary: Across twelve constructed tasks, one-step lookahead completes 8 and two-step completes 10. Both miss longer turns. All twelve witnesses and 213 states/full masks pass independent replay. Precise fractional-speed braking is qualified separately.
boundary: Exposed model tasks, not road evidence. Two-step lookahead uses 6,899 transitions versus 908; equal caps do not establish equal realized cost or superiority. No RRT solve or source comparison. The all-task qualification claim is contradicted.
next: Qualify control selection over the full maneuver horizon, then the integrated RRT under its existing four-case contract, before another source comparison.
